hypotheses.hypothesis: The checkout service experienced errors during the incident window due to failed calls to the product catalog service
hypotheses.evidence: checkout's outgoing GetProduct calls to product-catalog failed at 0.0082/s at 07:11, the same rate as its failing PlaceOrder (6 % of orders); nothing at the baseline 07:00:45. It is checkout's only failing client call, so the failed orders are explained by the catalog calls. Run 1; the alert (ShopCheckoutErrors) named checkout, the agent added the downstream cause.

hypotheses.hypothesis: The `product-catalog` service itself was returning errors on `oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct` spans, which propagated up to the checkout and frontend services
hypotheses.evidence: product-catalog answered 0.149 failed GetProduct/s at 07:11 (8 % of its 1.87 GetProduct/s); nothing at the baseline 07:00:45. This goes beyond the alerts: ShopServiceErrors listed product-catalog among four services, the agent singled it out as the origin. It is one of three faults; the agent never looked at ad's latency or recommendation's behaviour.

hypotheses.hypothesis: **`frontend`**, **`frontend-proxy`**, **`product-catalog`**, **`checkout`**, and the **`load-generator`** experienced error spikes starting around `07:05Z` / `07:09Z`.
hypotheses.evidence: frontend answered 0.29 failed requests/s at 07:11 (none at the baseline), and the load generator's failed calls rose from 0.12/s ten minutes earlier to 0.30/s, so both ends of the list really spiked; product-catalog and checkout are H2 and H1. Run 2. The list largely repeats the four services of the ShopServiceErrors alert; the load generator is the agent's own addition.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Before `07:05Z`, the error rate across all services was essentially zero (`0`).
hypotheses.evidence: Evaluated at 07:11 with offset 7m, the window is 06:59-07:04, before the onset. The shop then failed 0.158 calls/s, all of them the load generator's own client calls (the healthy shop's known noise), so 'essentially zero across all services' is contradicted. The agent read its 1-minute-window queries, which return nothing for metrics pushed once a minute.
